content.text: Global search snippets that contain HTML entities for ampersands display wrong. A title stored as R&D roadmap becomes R&amp;D roadmap in the snippet, or sometimes R&D with a stripped character depending on the path.

Snippets should decode entities once and show a single ampersand. Double-encoding happens because the search indexer escapes HTML before Elasticsearch, and the snippet highlighter escapes again when building highlight.fragments.
Readers scanning results for partner names with ampersands waste time opening the wrong hits. Decode before highlight, or mark fragments as already safe and skip the second escape.
